title: Practice 3: The present for the future, and «let's go»

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) и падаем.
exercises.why: **летим** — present tense (1st person plural) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) к реке.
exercises.why: **идём** — present tense (1st person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) к тому.
exercises.why: **идем** — present tense (1st person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) ко мне.
exercises.why: **идем** — present tense (1st person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Ко мне ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way).
exercises.why: **идёмте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: А куда ___ (побежать — to start running)?
exercises.why: **побежим** — future tense (1st person plural) of побежать: the perfective of бежать, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) ко мне!
exercises.why: **идём** — present tense (1st person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Так ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) же.
exercises.why: **идемте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (полететь — to fly off) лучше к Риму.
exercises.why: **полетим** — future tense (1st person plural) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».

exercises.q: Ну иди, ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way)!
exercises.why: **иди** — imperative (ты, singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) за нами!
exercises.why: **иди** — imperative (ты, singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) со мной.
exercises.why: **идемте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Я выйду, и мы ___ (полететь — to fly off).
exercises.why: **полетим** — future tense (1st person plural) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way), что ли?.
exercises.why: **идёмте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Ну ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) же!
exercises.why: **пойдемте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) в сад.
exercises.why: **пойдемте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) в лес!
exercises.why: **пойдём** — future tense (1st person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: И мы ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle))!
exercises.why: **поедем** — future tense (1st person plural) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle)) и вы.
exercises.why: **поедемте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) к нам!
exercises.why: **пойдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
